_about: The compatibility table on /anyps/ (assets/pages/anyps-plus.js, feature apCompat). systems = one row per console with its emulator's overall state. games = titles actually played through AnyPS; add a row whenever you try one. status is one of: great (plays start to finish, no fuss), playable (plays, with a minor hitch or a setting), issues (starts, but something big is wrong), nogo (doesn't run yet). note and fix are optional, plain text. Keep it honest: only list what has really been tested.
tested: Statuses for individual games come from playing them through AnyPS on a desktop with a recent 12-core CPU, an RTX-class graphics card and 32 GB of RAM. The per-system rows summarise each emulator project's own public results.

systems.note: Close to the whole library runs, at higher resolutions than the original.
The large majority of games are playable start to finish.
Near-complete; most games run at several times native resolution.
Varies a lot by game: some play well, many don't get past the start yet.
Thousands of titles are playable; heavier games want a strong CPU.
Early days: a handful of games run, most don't get far yet. Game support is the limit, not your PC.
